properties.name: jeap.opensearch.indexwriter.connection.url
properties.description: The URL of the OpenSearch cluster (e.g. https://my-opensearch-host:9200).

properties.name: jeap.opensearch.indexwriter.connection.signing-region
properties.description: AWS region for SigV4 request signing (e.g. eu-central-2). When set, requests are signed using the default AWS credential provider chain (ECS task role, EC2 instance profile, etc.). Leave blank for non-AWS deployments.
